# AI Project Conventions

This file is regenerated by [agnostic-ai](https://github.com/chemaclass/agnostic-ai). Every supported AI tool reads a copy of this body from its native entry-point (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, CONVENTIONS.md, ...) so a single source of truth drives every target.

## Where the specs live

- **Agents**: `agents/`
- **Skills**: `skills/`
- **Rules**: `rules/` (one file per rule)
- **Hooks**: `hooks/` (rendered into the target-native location)
- **MCP servers**: `mcps/`

## Workflow

- Author specs under the directories above.
- Run `agnostic-ai sync` to regenerate per-target output files.
- Edit only the source specs; the per-target files (including this one) are overwritten on each sync.
